items.author: chatgpt-codex-connector[bot]
items.body:
**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Preserve nonempty unlabeled panes before closing a worker tab**

When an added worker's tab also contains an unlabeled pane with a running agent (for example, a user opened a helper agent in that tab), this predicate accepts it merely because its label is empty, and `herdr tab close` then terminates that unrelated pane during `--remove-worker`. Require unlabeled panes to be agentless before treating them as the disposable empty shell described above.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

items.author: moriya-fumio-thd
items.body: Disposition (orchestrator acceptance): fixed in 958468ba (`close_worker_tab` treats an unlabelled pane as disposable only when it has no agent; verified in the diff).
